facts.claim: Nana Princess (Chersonissos, Crete, on the Aegean coast) has an official weddings page offering civil weddings on its private sandy beach, Greek Orthodox weddings in the private Chapel of St. George in the hotel grounds, symbolic weddings officiated by its event coordinator, and vow renewals; it describes the resort as suited to small to medium sized events. Re-check of Greece pack fact_609.

Nana Princess offers exclusive use of the chosen room or venue for symbolic weddings and vow renewals. Reception options are the terrace of the Eternal Blue restaurant overlooking the bay of Stalis, a poolside reception at the Meat-In-Point restaurant seating up to 120 guests, and the Conference Hall for larger receptions needing a fully covered space. Re-check of Greece pack fact_610.

Nana Princess notes high-summer temperatures in Greece can reach 35 degrees C and recommends evening ceremony times: 16:00 to 18:00 in April, May and October; 18:00 to 20:00 in June to September; 18:30 to 20:00 in July and August. Re-check of Greece pack fact_611.

Nana Princess publishes three named wedding packages (Deluxe Dream, Ultimate Passion, Essential Elegance) and offers bespoke packages; a dedicated event coordinator guides couples through local registry office requirements and other formalities. Re-check of Greece pack fact_612.

Amirandes, Grecotel (north coast of Crete near Heraklion) says on its weddings, meetings and events page that couples can exchange vows at its VIP Beach or in its chapel, choose from diverse dining venues, and plan with dedicated wedding specialists; the page links a wedding request form.

Amirandes lists celebrations of up to 300 guests across its venues, with six meeting rooms and indoor and outdoor spaces; its resort page gives a seaside vow on the VIP Beach for up to 80 guests and a private gathering on the Events Patio for 20 to 160 guests.

Amirandes has 204 accommodations in total (147 rooms, 19 bungalows, 6 duplex suites, 14 suites and 18 private villas, some beachfront with infinity pools), and sits 18 km from Heraklion International Airport (the events page says about 15 minutes) and a short drive from the Palace of Knossos.

Amirandes' architecture draws on Minoan palace design, with lagoons, arches and large handmade pitharia jars, a 960 square metre seawater Olympic-size pool, 58 private pools, and the Minotaur restaurant set among original Pablo Picasso ceramics.

Out of the Blue Resort & Spa (Agia Pelagia, Heraklion, Crete) has an official weddings page: it describes the resort as privately set on a green peninsula, with a dedicated events team and downloadable wedding packages and private venues documents.

Out of the Blue lists Aghios Athanasios Chapel, a small privately owned traditional chapel in the heart of the resort used for prayers, weddings and baptisms, with a garden and sea views where events can take place; outdoor venues Emelia's Secret Garden (Souda Garden) among palm trees and Plateau Safran, a lawn on the edge of the peninsula that can host wedding ceremonies; and restaurants with indoor and outdoor areas for ceremonies and receptions. No guest capacity is stated on the weddings page.

Abaton Island Resort & Spa (Hersonissos, Crete) has an official weddings page: its Wedding & Honeymoon team offers set wedding packages or a custom wedding at the couple's preferred Abaton wedding venue, with a 2025-2026 wedding brochure, and lists ceremony, music, flowers, decor, beauty, cocktail bar, gala dinner, photography and video as options to customise.

Caramel, Grecotel Boutique Resort (Adelianos Kampos, Rethymno, on Crete's north coast) has an official weddings and vow renewals page. It says informal weddings and exchange-of-vows packages are the most popular ceremony at the hotel and that couples do not need to handle paperwork or legal requirements for these, which indicates symbolic (non-legal) ceremonies; no legal ceremony option or capacity is stated on the page.

Abaton's 2025-2026 wedding brochure (linked from its official weddings page) lists nine wedding venues: Elemes, Bony Fish, F-Zin, WOW, Ladies & Gentlemen, Buddha Bar, the Open Air Theatre, the Ballroom and the Beach. Published capacities: Elemes 80, Bony Fish 70, F-Zin 100 indoors or 200 outdoors, WOW 80, Ladies & Gentlemen 200 (ceremony and cocktail only), Buddha Bar 200, Open Air Theatre 200, Ballroom 150; the Beach capacity is not stated.

Abaton's wedding brochure terms say packages need a wedding reception booking of at least 20 guests (maximum capacity 300 guests) and a minimum accommodation booking of 10 rooms for at least 2 nights (depending on guest numbers); the resort offers 152 rooms and villas, 71 with private pools, along the coastline.

Out of the Blue Resort & Spa is spread across its own private peninsula next to the traditional fishing village of Agia Pelagia, with Aegean views, and has three accommodation collections (a modern-art inspired boutique hotel, bungalows, an all-suite hotel, maisonettes and villas with private pools). Room count is not stated on the pages checked.

Caramel sits on Crete's north coast minutes from the historic town of Rethymno, among gardens above a golden-sand beach where caretta caretta sea turtles nest; it describes a retro glamour style with individually designed rooms, a 700 square metre seawater pool, and suites, bungalows, maisonettes and villas, some with private pools. Room count is not stated on the pages checked.

Kapsaliana Village Hotel (Kapsaliana, Rethymno, Crete) has an official Meetings & Events page that presents the restored village for corporate events, small conferences and wellness retreats, accommodating up to 50 people, with 70 seated or 120 for finger food; the page does not mention weddings, so the venue does not meet the inclusion rule on its own site as checked.

Lyrarakis Wines (family winery at Alagni, Heraklion, set among the Psarades vineyard below the Lassithi mountains, producing since 1966) offers wine tastings, vineyard picnics and olive oil tastings on its official visit page; the official site does not present weddings, and the venue site it links (lyrarakis-venue.com) resolved to a parked domain when checked, so the winery does not meet the inclusion rule as checked.

insider_details.detail: Nana Princess publishes its own ceremony timing guide: late afternoon (16:00 to 18:00) in April, May and October, and no earlier than 18:00 from June to September, so build the transfer and photography schedule backwards from an evening ceremony.

Amirandes is the most airport-friendly option in this group at 18 km from Heraklion International Airport, which suits guests arriving on staggered flights; its 204 rooms and 18 private villas also make it possible to keep most of a guest list on one site.
Amirandes caps a beach ceremony at 80 guests, while the Events Patio takes 20 to 160, so couples with a larger list should plan the vows and the reception in different spaces.
Abaton is one of the few Crete resorts to publish its wedding terms: packages assume at least 20 reception guests and a block of at least 10 rooms for 2 nights, so confirm your room block early.
Out of the Blue sits on its own peninsula with a private chapel and two lawn venues at the water's edge, so the ceremony, photos and reception can all happen without guests leaving the resort.
Caramel frames its weddings as informal vow ceremonies with no paperwork, which suits couples who complete the legal marriage in Australia and want a relaxed beach celebration in Rethymno.
